scripts.start: npm run migrate:vat && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend "npm run frontend" "npm run backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.restore:backend: scripts\dotnet.cmd restore apps/backend/Vat.Api/Vat.Api.csproj --configfile NuGet.Config && scripts\dotnet.cmd restore apps/backend/Vat.Migrations/Vat.Migrations.csproj --configfile NuGet.Config && scripts\dotnet.cmd restore apps/backend/Vat.Migrations.Tests/Vat.Migrations.Tests.csproj --configfile NuGet.Config && scripts\dotnet.cmd restore apps/backend/Vat.Api.Tests/Vat.Api.Tests.csproj --configfile NuGet.Config
